jobs.occupation: Data Platform Engineer – Offshore Wind Industry
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about building and running reliable, scalable and secure cloud data platforms? Do you want to work in the offshore wind industry, where your engineering skills will help secure a sustainable future based on renewable energy? Then keep reading: Cadeler is looking for a Data Platform Engineer with your skills and interests!

Cadeler is a global partner in the offshore wind industry, specializing in wind farm construction and maintenance. Our industry is more relevant than ever and plays a critical role in the energy transition, with a strong long-term outlook. As our industry continues to develop, so do we!

We are now looking for a Data Platform Engineer to help build, automate and operate our cloud data platform, ensuring that trusted and well-governed data is available for analytics, reporting and operational decision-making.

**What will you do?

**As our Data Platform Engineer, you will design, build and operate the technical foundations of Cadeler's data platform on Snowflake and Azure. You will work with business teams, application owners, IT and information security to integrate source systems, automate data pipelines and make reliable data available for analytics and reporting.

**Your Main Tasks Include

**

• Design, build and maintain data pipelines from various source systems, using managed ingestion tools such as Fivetran and custom Python where connectors fall short

• Orchestrate and schedule pipelines, handle dependencies, retries and backfills, and manage Snowflake warehouse sizing and compute cost

• Own CI/CD and source control in Azure DevOps: branching strategy, PR reviews, automated deployments and environment promotion (dev, test, prod), with database objects and infrastructure managed as code

• Design and implement dimensional data models (facts, dimensions, star schemas, slowly changing dimensions) across raw, staging, integration and mart layers

• Set up pipeline monitoring, anomaly detection and alerting, and troubleshoot and resolve incidents in production

• Deliver curated, performant datasets and semantic-ready measures so departments can build reports in Power BI

**To Succeed In This Role

**Being part of the Cadeler community means having a natural interest in and care for the environment, and in our shared mission to speed up the green energy transition. Environmental considerations and the safety of our people and the planet will be a key priority in your daily work.

We are looking for an innovator with a solution-oriented mind, who thrives in a fast-paced environment with many different interfaces.

We think you will be a good match if you have:

• A university degree in a relevant area such as computing, statistics or mathematics

• 3+ years of hands-on experience as a data engineer or data platform engineer

• Proven experience designing, building and operating production data pipelines

• Advanced SQL skills and strong Python skills for data processing, automation and tooling, and experience with dimensional modelling

• Hands-on experience with Snowflake (warehouses, RBAC, storage and compute management, cost control) and the Azure ecosystem

• An understanding of data security, governance and access control principles, as well as ability to define and write logic that transforms raw data into useful, interpretable, business-driven datasets

• Fluent spoken and written English

**Come work with us!

**By becoming a Cadeler employee, you will be part of a rapidly growing company with a diverse and energetic team. We offer an exciting position focused on delivering excellence in the face of interesting new challenges, within a positive and rewarding work environment in an international company with great development possibilities.

Cadeler is headquartered in Copenhagen, with offices in Vejle, Norwich, Rotterdam and Taipei, as well as colleagues working offshore aboard our fleet of Wind Farm Installation Vessels (WFIV).

Meet some of our colleagues here: https://www.cadeler.com/career

**Apply

**Use the APPLY button to apply for this position. For data protection purposes, applications are only accepted via the link and are assessed continuously until we find the right candidate, so please don't hesitate to send in your application as soon as possible and no later than the 6th of November.

If you have any questions about the position, and/or for practical matters, please contact peopleandculture@cadeler.com.

jobs.occupation: Technical Project Manager, CS
jobs.description:
Technical Project Manager, CS

Are you a dedicated project manager with a strong technical understanding and a passion for delivering successful customer projects? Do you thrive in a role where you coordinate stakeholders, manage project execution, and ensure customer satisfaction? Then you might be the Technical Project Manager we are looking for in our Customer Services team at Körber Supply Chain.

As our new Technical Project Manager, you will be responsible for managing and delivering minor and middle size Customer service project with a variety in complexity from initial order intake through execution and successful Delivery. Acting as the central point of contact, you will collaborate closely with customers, suppliers, technicians, and internal stakeholders to ensure projects are delivered according to agreed scope, quality, timelines, and budget.

In this role, you will work closely with our sales organization during the project clarification phase, helping define customer requirements, technical specifications, project scope, objectives, and success criteria. You will be responsible for developing and maintaining project plans, schedules, budgets, and risk assessments while ensuring effective communication and coordination throughout the entire project lifecycle. Furthermore, you will oversee the procurement of equipment, components, and resources, monitor project finances, manage changes in project scope and priorities, and ensure that all deliverables meet customer expectations and agreed performance targets.

The position requires a structured and analytical professional who can balance technical detail with commercial understanding. You are comfortable working independently, taking ownership of your projects, and navigating complex situations while maintaining focus on deadlines, quality, and customer satisfaction. You enjoy building relationships and collaborating across functions and cultures, and you are able to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

We imagine that you have 3-5 years of experience from a similar project management role, preferably within a technical, industrial, automation, or engineering environment. You possess a strong technical understanding and are comfortable reviewing and working with technical documentation and system specifications. Experience with project management tools is expected, and fluency in Danish and English is required. As some projects involve on-site activities, a willingness to travel is also important.

At Körber Supply Chain, you will become part of an international organization and a highly skilled Customer Services team where collaboration, professionalism, and continuous improvement are key. You will have the opportunity to work on exciting technical projects, develop your competencies, and play an important role in supporting our customers' operations and long-term success.

This position is also an important part of the planned succession within our Customer Services Sales & Specialist team. Through close collaboration with experienced colleagues, you will gain valuable knowledge and insight, ensuring a strong foundation for future success in the role.

Why Should You Join Körber Supply Chain DK?

We offer an exciting role in an international company in growth, where you will work with advanced technical solutions and be part of a strong professional environment characterized by collaboration and dedication. We offer a range of attractive employee benefits:

Security & Health: In addition to a competitive salary package, you will be enrolled in our mandatory pension scheme, which also includes both health insurance and dental insurance, as well as access to physiotherapy. You will also be part of our lunch program, where our canteen provides healthy and exciting meals every day.

Development: We continuously offer training and courses, as we believe that our success is built on satisfied and skilled employees. That’s why we focus on both personal and professional development to ensure continuous growth.

Social Events: We have a strong company culture that we invest heavily in maintaining and developing. This includes a wide range of events and an active employee association that organizes activities such as Friday bars, Christmas parties, an annual ski trip, cultural events, and much more!

Körber – Conquer Supply Chain Complexity

We value diversity and welcome all applicants, regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social background, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation, identity, or any other protected status.

Apply now:

If you would like to create your future as a part of the Körber Supply Chain DK A/S team, please forward your application and CV already today!

Applications for this position have no deadline, as we will include candidates in the recruitment process on a continuous basis and will close the process once we have found the right candidate.

Apply now and join our team!

Ready for your next step? Click on ‘Apply now’ to get started right away! As long as the position is advertised, you can apply at any time.

We value diversity and therefore welcome all applicants - regardless of gender, nationality, ethnic or social origin, religion/belief, disability, age, sexual orientation and identity, and any other protected status. You can find out more about our culture here Culture at Körber - it's worth taking a look!

If you have any questions or technical problems, please send us an e-mail to jobs@koerber.com.

As a reliable innovation partner, Körber turns entrepreneurial thinking into customer success by providing leading technology to fuel what’s next – from end-to-end pharma production and advanced supply chain solutions to high-tech machinery and process equipment. Körber combines deep domain expertise with integrated hardware, software, and digital services, to help customers take the next step.

jobs.occupation: Product Manager
jobs.description:
The role

We are looking for a Product Manager to join our Product Management team in Aarhus.

The team is still being built. Today, problem framing, epic work, roadmap, customer dialogue and design coordination sit in one place. That limits how many product tracks we can run properly at the same time. You give us the capacity to go deep on several at once, so we can move from reacting to demand to driving a coherent product.

We serve four markets and four customer types with one platform. That takes discipline about what becomes configuration and what becomes a special build. Holding that line, with a rationale that also holds up in front of a customer, is a real part of the job.

We work AI-augmented. Modern AI tools take more of the writing and synthesis off your desk, which makes judgement the valuable work: which problem is real, what we build, and what we decline. We use AI to move faster, and we believe people are what make sure we build the right things.

Your work reaches hundreds of thousands of people across the Nordics: job seekers navigating labour market reforms, employment professionals adapting to new digitalisation strategies, and the institutions managing that change.

What you will work on

Candeno serves municipalities, unemployment funds, and educational institutions across Denmark, Norway, Sweden, and Finland. The platform has three sides: candidates navigating the labour market, advisors guiding them through digitalisation and compliance workflows, and companies recruiting talent. One platform, many contexts.

To begin with, the role is deliberately broad. You work across customers, markets, segments and products, wherever the need is greatest. A fixed ownership area is set as the team grows. You will:

Discovery and problem framing

• 
Turn input from customers, Customer Success, sales and Product Support into qualified problem statements.

• 
Run and facilitate user interviews, workshops and validation together with design.

• 
Understand the problem before the solution, and get discovery done before we estimate.

Definition and delivery

• 
Write epics and solution descriptions others can build on, with scope, boundaries and success criteria.

• 
Prioritise and drive the backlog together with engineering and architecture.

• 
Follow deliveries all the way out: release notes, internal enablement, and follow-up on real impact.

Customer and market dialogue

• 
Take part in customer dialogue and workshops with Customer Success and sales, without committing to functionality on the spot.

• 
Assess feature requests across customers: what is one customer's edge case, and what is a shared need.

Direction and communication

• 
Contribute to roadmap, themes and horizons (Now, Next, Later).

• 
Make sure cross-cutting dependencies such as integrations, data and compliance are understood before we commit to building.

Your mandate

You prioritise within an agreed direction, you can say no to special builds, and you decide within your own track. Overall direction, cross-cutting prioritisation and roadmap commitments sit with the Head of Product Management.

Who we are looking for

You are a product manager who loves the problem. You go deep on the challenge before you reach for a solution, you write clearly enough that other people can act on it, and you are comfortable in an organisation where the frame is not finished yet.

You will need:

• 
Experience as a Product Manager or Product Owner on a SaaS product.

• 
The ability to run discovery independently: talk to users, synthesise what you hear, and turn it into problems and requirements.

• 
Clear and structured writing. Epics, problem statements and decision papers other people can act on.

• 
Experience working closely with engineers and designers in a team with real ownership.

• 
Danish and English at working level, written and spoken.

Nice to have:

• 
Knowledge of the employment sector, public sector customers, or other regulated domains.

• 
Experience with multi-tenant products, configurability and white-label.

• 
Experience with B2G sales and decision processes, where a decision takes 6 to 24 months and involves many stakeholders.

• 
A considered approach to AI in your own product work, including judgement about when the output needs verifying.

• 
Enough understanding of integrations and data models to ask the right questions.

The kind of person who does well here:

• 
Loves the problem. Goes deep on the challenge before the solution.

• 
Self-driven where the frame is not finished, and helps build it.

• 
Honest and direct, including when the answer is no, or not yet.

• 
Has empathy for all three parties: the job seeker, the advisor and the customer.

• 
Comfortable with breadth, and with switching between segments and markets.

• 
Collaborates rather than hands over.

What the first six months look like

After one month

You know the platform as a user, on both the candidate and the advisor side, and you can explain what we solve and for whom. You have met product, design, engineering, Customer Success and sales, and you know who to go to when. You have listened in on customer dialogue and support cases across all three customer segments, and you have taken ownership of a first, well-defined problem.

After three months

You run discovery independently on your own tracks and deliver problem statements and epics the team can build on. You have taken at least one delivery from problem to release and followed up on the impact. You contribute credibly to prioritisation, you can turn down a special build with a rationale that holds, and you handle customer dialogue independently alongside Customer Success.

After six months

You have full ownership of one or more product areas and you are the team's go-to person on them. You contribute to roadmap and direction, not only to execution. You have moved a measurable outcome for customers or users, and you have changed something about how we work, not only about the product.

Working at Candeno

We are a scale-up. That means real ownership, real impact, and a product that is still being shaped by the people who work on it.

We are based in Aarhus, and this is an on-site role. You report to the Head of Product Management and work in a product trio with design and architecture throughout, close to engineering, Customer Success, sales and Product Support.

Our product philosophy follows Cagan and SVPG: outcome-oriented teams, discovery before estimation, and configurability over special builds. We work in ClickUp for epics and backlog, Figma and FigJam for design and concept work, and Freshdesk for release communication. We work in Danish and English. Swedish and Norwegian are handled together with colleagues.

We are direct and focused on doing the right thing for users. We share work early and expect you to do the same.

What we offer

• 
Pension scheme and health insurance

• 
5 extra days off after 2 years of seniority (10 in total)

• 
Daily lunch from Meyers Madhus

• 
A shared milestone programme that celebrates successes big and small

• 
An active social life: team events, clubs, and an engaged social committee

The process

• 
A short screening call with the Head of Product Management

• 
A first interview with the Head of Product Management and the CTO, a deeper conversation about your experience and the role

• 
A case interview, a practical brief sent in advance

No cover letter. You will answer three short questions when you apply.

About Candeno

Candeno is a Nordic employment technology company based in Aarhus. We build the platform that connects candidates, advisors, and companies across municipalities, unemployment funds, and educational institutions in Denmark, Norway, Sweden, and Finland. Our work sits at the intersection of public sector compliance and modern product thinking, and we take both seriously.

jobs.occupation: Engineering Manager
jobs.description:
The role

We are looking for an Engineering Manager to lead our Product Engineering team in Aarhus.

This is a leadership role, not a hands-on coding role. You own the production engine of Product Engineering: the people, the process, and the tools that turn ideas into shipped software. Your job is to build a strong team, keep our way of working lean and effective, and make sure engineers have the environments they need to do great work.

We work AI-augmented. Modern AI tools are a natural part of how we design, write and review software, so more of the typing is handled for us. That makes judgement the valuable work: what to build and whether it holds up as the platform grows. You make sure the team gets the most out of that, while keeping delivery healthy and predictable.

You join the Products leadership group and report to the CTO. The Lead Architect owns the platform, including the production platform. You own the people, process, and tools that build and deliver on it. The two roles work closely and depend on each other.

Your team's work reaches hundreds of thousands of people across the Nordics: job seekers navigating labour market reforms, employment professionals adapting to new digitalisation strategies, and the institutions managing that change.

What you will work on

Candeno serves municipalities, unemployment funds, and educational institutions across Denmark, Norway, Sweden, and Finland. The platform has three sides: candidates navigating the labour market, advisors guiding them through digitalisation and compliance workflows, and companies recruiting talent. One platform, many contexts.

You will lead a team of up to 15 engineers, growing through our H2 2026 upscaling. You will:

People

• 
Take full personnel responsibility for the engineers: performance, development, wellbeing, and day-to-day leadership.

• 
Run regular one-to-ones, give feedback, and set clear development plans for each engineer.

• 
Own hiring for the team, and handle underperformance and offboarding when needed.

• 
Grow the team through the upscaling, and build a culture of ownership and craft.

Process (delivery)

• 
Own the delivery part of the process (build and operate), and align closely with the discovery part (analysis and design), which is owned by the Head of Product Management.

• 
Keep delivery predictable and healthy: sensible planning, clear priorities, and steady flow, without heavy ceremony.

• 
Make sure AI tools are used well across the team, so we work faster and still build the right things.

• 
Remove blockers and protect focus time so the team can deliver.

Tools

• 
Own the development and test environments, and keep them reliable, fast, and fit for purpose.

• 
Work with the Lead Architect so tooling and environments fit the platform and production setup.

• 
Keep improving the developer experience as the team grows.

Who we are looking for

You are an engineering leader who builds strong teams and lean delivery. You have a solid engineering background, enough to earn the respect of senior engineers and to partner with a Lead Architect, even if you are no longer hands-on in code.

You will need:

• 
Proven experience leading and developing software engineering teams, with real people management responsibility.

• 
A track record of building lean, effective delivery in a fast-moving SaaS or product company.

• 
A solid engineering background across modern web or SaaS development.

• 
Experience with modern delivery tooling: development and test environments, CI/CD, containers, and running services in the cloud.

• 
A considered approach to AI. You help a team use modern AI tools well, and keep a critical eye on what they produce.

• 
Experience hiring, and comfort handling performance and difficult conversations.

• 
Clear communication. You can align engineers, product, and leadership, and make it feel simple.

• 
The kind of person who does well here:

• 
A leader people want to work for: supportive, clear, and fair.

• 
Decisive. You own the hard calls on people and priorities.

• 
Bias for a lean, pragmatic process over heavy structure.

• 
Curious about the problem, not only the delivery.

• 
Direct. You give feedback clearly and push back when something is not right.

What the first six months look like

After one month

You know the team, the platform, and our discovery and delivery process. You have started one-to-ones and built trust with each engineer, and you understand the current state of our development and test environments.

After three months

You own the development process day to day, with clear priorities and steady delivery. Each engineer has a development plan, and you have a plan for improving the environments. You are an active member of the Products leadership group.

After six months

Your team delivers predictably and owns its way of working. You have grown the team as planned through the upscaling, with a strong hiring bar, and you have measurably improved delivery, developer experience, and the environments.

Working at Candeno

We are a scale-up. That means real ownership, real impact, and a product that is still being shaped by the people who work on it.

We are based in Aarhus, and this is an on-site role. You join the Products leadership group, reporting to the CTO, and you work closely with the Lead Architect, the Head of Product Management, and the Product Support Manager.

We are direct and focused on doing the right thing for users. We share work early and expect you to do the same.

What we offer

• 
Pension scheme and health insurance

• 
5 extra days off after 2 years of seniority (10 in total)

• 
Daily lunch from Meyers Madhus

• 
A shared milestone programme that celebrates successes big and small

• 
An active social life: team events, clubs, and an engaged social committee

Before you apply

This is a fully on-site role in Aarhus with no remote option. You must already have the right to work in Denmark and be able to be in our office every working day from your start date. We do not offer visa sponsorship or relocation support. Applications that do not meet these conditions will not be considered, so please only apply if all of them apply to you.

The process

• 
A short screening call

• 
A first interview, a deeper conversation about your experience and the role

• 
A case interview, a practical brief sent in advance

No cover letter. You will answer three short questions when you apply.

About Candeno

Candeno is a Nordic employment technology company based in Aarhus. We build the platform that connects candidates, advisors, and companies across municipalities, unemployment funds, and educational institutions in Denmark, Norway, Sweden, and Finland. Our work sits at the intersection of public sector compliance and modern product thinking, and we take both seriously.

jobs.occupation: Senior Specialist, Global Process Monitoring
jobs.description:
_Do you enjoy turning complex process and operational data into meaningful improvements? And would you like to help build a more connected, data-driven way of monitoring and improving global processes?

_As our new Senior Specialist, Global Process Monitoring, you will help make the health of our global Order-to-Cash processes visible, measurable and actionable. You will work across functions and regions to identify systemic issues, uncover their root causes and ensure that sustainable improvements are implemented at the source, rather than repeatedly resolving the same symptoms.

**Your role

**Joining Global Operations Excellence, you will take ownership of global process monitoring, bringing together insights from local process-monitoring teams across our Distribution Centres.

Through regular end-to-end monitoring, you will transform process and ERP data into early warnings, actionable insights and clear improvement priorities. With a global overview of process performance and bottlenecks, you will help ensure that the right issues receive the right attention from Distribution Centres, Global Process Owners and other key stakeholders.

You will work closely with colleagues across Operations, Application Management, Master Data, Global Business Services, Data & Analytics, Digital & Technology and Finance. You will also help identify opportunities where analytics, data and AI-enabled capabilities can improve operational performance and create measurable business value.

**Key Responsibilities

**

• Own the global process-monitoring approach, incorporating insights from local teams across our Distribution Centres.

• Proactively identify issues and improvement opportunities throughout the end-to-end Order-to-Cash process.

• Turn process and ERP data into early warnings, root-cause insights and actionable recommendations.

• Govern and prioritise the global issue-resolution backlog together with Global Process Owners and Distribution Centres.

• Drive alignment across regions, Distribution Centres and global functions to support continuous process improvement.

• Identify opportunities for AI-enabled process optimisation.

• Build strong partnerships across Operations, Data & Analytics, and Digital & Technology.

• Support the adoption of increasingly data-driven and AI-enabled ways of working across Operation.

**What You Bring

**You combine a strong analytical mindset with the ability to influence, collaborate and create progress across functions. You are comfortable navigating complex processes and can translate data and operational insights into clear priorities and sustainable improvements.

**We Imagine That You Have

**

• Approximately three to five years of relevant experience, or an equivalent combination of education and professional experience.

• Experience within analytics, performance management, process improvement or operational excellence.

• A strong understanding of KPI frameworks, business-performance measurement and data-driven decision-making.

• Experience working across multiple operational functions, ideally within an international or global environment.

• The ability to influence stakeholders and establish alignment across teams and functions.

• An understanding of modern analytics, data governance and AI-enabled business capabilities.

• A bachelor’s degree within Supply Chain Management, Operations Management, Business Administration, Engineering, Economics, Analytics, Data Management or a related discipline.

• Experience working with reporting and analytics platforms, together with strong Microsoft Office skills.

• Professional fluency in written and spoken English.

**Your personal qualities

**You are curious, proactive and motivated by solving problems at their source. You approach challenges with a strategic and analytical mindset, while remaining collaborative and approachable in your work with others.

You communicate complex topics clearly, make considered decisions and maintain momentum across different stakeholder groups. Most importantly, you bring a continuous-improvement mindset and a genuine interest in how data, technology and AI can contribute to better business processes

**Additional Information

**

• Global Career Band 5A

**Did we get your attention?

**If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora’s future, please do not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!

We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your application as soon as possible.

You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site www.pandoragroup.com.

**About Pandora

**Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire self-expression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery. Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 7,000 points of sale, including more than 2,800 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs around 39,000 people worldwide and crafts its jewellery with 100% recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 32.5 billion (EUR 4.4 billion) in 2025.

Recognised by the Financial Times as one of Europe’s Best Workplaces and ranked #1 among Danish companies, Pandora is committed to building an inclusive and diverse workplace. We believe that reflecting the diversity of society in how we engage with our customers is essential to fulfilling our purpose: to give a voice to people’s loves. We are dedicated to nurturing a culture where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to thrive.

jobs.occupation: People Partner
jobs.description:
Make an impact with us

At Milestone Systems, what you do matters. People are at the heart of everything we do, grounded in integrity, collaboration, strong relationships, and a curiosity that drives continuous learning. It is how we work together, learn from one another, embrace new perspectives, and create lasting impact.

In this role, you will be a trusted partner to managers and teams, helping them turn business priorities into value adding people actions. You will create impact through thoughtful coaching, strong relationships and the confidence to help managers build strong teams.

About the role

As People Partner, you will own the people partnership for your assigned business areas. You will work closely with managers, leadership teams and, when relevant, their teams to strengthen leadership, engagement, performance and organisational effectiveness.

You will report to the Head of People & Culture HQ and become part of our global People & Culture team, collaborating with colleagues across regions and specialist areas.

What makes this role interesting is the breadth. One day you may coach a manager through a sensitive performance conversation; the next, you may facilitate a leadership-team workshop, support a recruitment process or turn engagement insights into focused action. You will have room to influence, while staying close to the managers and teams you support.

What you will do

• Partner with managers, leadership teams and, when relevant, their teams to understand business priorities and translate them into focused people plans and actions.

• Coach and challenge managers on leadership dilemmas, team effectiveness, engagement, development and retention, building their confidence to lead well.

• Guide managers through employee relations and performance matters including difficult conversations, performance improvement plans, disciplinary issues and terminations, with clear documentation and sound judgement.

• Drive key people processes such as talent reviews, performance management, annual salary review and individual development follow-up.

• Use people data and insight including engagement results and workforce information, to identify priorities, support decisions and follow through on actions.

• Support organisation design, workforce planning and change by facilitating discussions, challenging assumptions and helping leaders make sustainable decisions.

• Support recruitment and facilitate team interventions by partnering with hiring managers on recruitments, and by planning and facilitating workshops for leadership teams and employee groups.

What you bring

We are looking for someone with:

• 5-8 years of experience as an HR Business Partner, People Partner or in a comparable broad people role, ideally in an international or matrix organisation.

• Strong experience coaching and advising managers at different levels, with the credibility to be supportive, candid and appropriately challenging.

• Hands-on experience with performance management and employee relations, including sensitive conversations, performance improvement and organisational change.

• A good understanding of talent, engagement, workforce planning, organisation design and reward processes, and how these areas connect to business outcomes.

• The ability to use people data to spot patterns, frame choices and support practical decision-making.

jobs.occupation: Advances in NMR techniques for next generation Foodomics
jobs.description:
Applicants are invited for a PhD fellowship/scholarship at Graduate School of Technical Sciences, Aarhus University, Denmark, within the Food Science programme. The position is available from 01 February 2026 or later. You can submit your application via the link under 'how to apply'.

Title
Advances in NMR techniques for next generation Foodomics

Research area and project description
The Department of Food Science at Aarhus University is inviting applications for a Ph.D. student position focused on the development and applications of NMR spectroscopy in the characterization of foods - Foodomics.

Foodomics is a scientific approach that studies food, nutrition and their effects on health using omics technologies. NMR spectroscopy has played a key role in establishing Foodomics and has offered distinctive insights into foods’ health-promoting potential as well as their functional characteristics. However, ¹H NMR spectroscopy, which is the current workhorse of NMR-based Foodomics, has some analytical limitations. Thus, spectral overlap renders substantial parts of the food metabolome unidentified.

This PhD project aims at developing and examining new and alternative NMR-based approaches within Foodomics. This includes elucidating the potential of ¹³C NMR spectroscopy, which so far has been limited applied in Foodomics. For this purpose, sensitivity-enhancement strategies will be explored, including a dissolution dynamic nuclear polarization technique (d-DNP). This will be done in collaboration with a prominent European d-DNP group.

The PhD project will entail studies on new foods of alternative sources and/or derived from innovative biotechnological processing techniques and solutions.

Tasks and responsibilities include:

• 
Conduct research on development and applications of NMR spectroscopy in food science.

• 
Collaborate with a multidisciplinary team including a 4-6-months stay in an international research environment abroad.

• 
Design and implement experiments, collect and analyse data, and interpret results.

• 
Present findings at conferences and publish research in reputable peer-reviewed journals.

• 
Participate in outreach activities to disseminate research outcomes to stakeholders and contribute to teaching in the department

Qualifications and specific competences
Applicants must have a relevant master’s degree (120 ECTS) in chemistry, biotechnology, food technology, or in a related field.

The preferred candidate has substantial hands-on experience in NMR spectroscopy. Relevant expertise in food science, foodomics, multivariate data analysis and good analytical skills is an advantage.

The successful candidate should be motivated to combine laboratory work and experiments, data processing and analysis and ability to work independently and as part of a team in an international research environment.

Title

Research area and project description
To move the green transition of the food sector forward, there is a need for novel ingredients from sustainable sources that provide the required functionality in food. Designing formulations with plant-based ingredients therefore requires an in-depth understanding not only of their structure and function in isolation but also of their interactions with other ingredients and their dynamics during processing.

This project will focus on protein structure–function relationships using complex model systems, such as emulsions, foams, and gels, applying advanced colloid science and soft matter techniques to embrace the complexity of food. The studies will be conducted at various length to move the green transition of the food sector forward; there is a need for novel ingredients from sustainable sources that provide the required functionality in food. Designing formulations with plant-based ingredients therefore requires an in-depth understanding not only of their structure and function in isolation but also of their interactions with other ingredients and their dynamics during processing.

This project will focus on protein structure–function relationships using complex model systems, such as emulsions, foams, and gels, applying advanced colloid science and soft matter techniques to embrace the complexity of food. Center for Familier er Aabenraa Kommunes institution på børne- og familieområdet. I Center for Familier løser vi opgaver inden for Barnets lov §32.
Vi varetager mange indsatser - herunder bl.a. familiebehandling; ambulant og i døgntilbud samt familiekonsulentstøtte. Vi matcher børn og unge med en kontaktperson og varetager anbringelse i plejefamilier og på døgninstitution. Vi løser også opgaver i forhold til støtteophold i dag- og døgntilbud.

Vi lægger stor vægt på, at forældre, børn og unge er aktører og har størst mulig indflydelse på eget liv.

Alle indsatser har til formål at få børnene og familierne i udvikling mod det gode almene liv. Vores faglige og teoretiske afsæt er bredt og tager udgangspunkt i den systemiske og narrative tænkning.

Principper om at samarbejdet med barnet/den unge/familien skal foregå tæt på hjemmet og netværket, herunder at det skal være dokumenteret og målbart, danner grundlag for arbejdet i Center for Familier.

supervision/sparring, råd-og vejledning til plejefamilier

undervisning og kurser til plejefamilier, støtte- og kontaktpersoner

match til plejefamilier, kontaktpersoner og støttepersoner

godkendelse af netværksplejefamilier, private godkendelser og § 84 godkendelser

rekruttering af støtte- og kontaktpersoner.

mulighed for at sætte dit præg på en afdeling i udvikling

et alsidigt, spændende og afvekslende job med mange forskellige opgaver

et stort selvstændig og koordinerende ansvar i opgaveløsningen, hvor du selv tilrettelægger dine arbejdstider

kreative og fagligt dygtige kollegaer, der brænder for arbejdet med at støtte plejefamilier i deres arbejde med udsatte børn, unge og familier

mulighed for og forventning til personlig udvikling og uddannelse

jobs.occupation: Postdoctoral Researcher in Real World Evidence for Knee Osteoarthritis
jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

We are seeking a postdoctoral researcher to help advance PROBE, an Innovative Health Initiative (IHI) public-private partnership focused on patient-relevant osteoarthritis endpoints using big data. You will be anchored in Novo Nordisk’s R&D Real World Evidence (RWE) area, with access to its scientific expertise and support network, and work closely with our Public-Private Partnerships (PPP) team and partners across the consortium.

Your main research focus will be PROBE Work Package 4 (WP4): analysing patient characteristics and identifying factors (such as clinical variables and biomarkers) associated with osteoarthritis progression, meaningful patient subgroups, and potential surrogates of clinically relevant outcomes. You will also help establish the infrastructure and authorised access needed for analysis in the federated database network and contribute to deliverables across other work packages.

What you'll bring

You have a PhD in epidemiology, biostatistics, data science, biomedical informatics, computational biology, public health, or a related field, together with experience analysing complex health data. We expect you to bring:

• 
Strong programming and reproducible analysis skills in R or Python, knowledge of modern machine learning/AI methods, and sound statistical reasoning.

• 
Experience with observational, registry, electronic health record, clinical, or other longitudinal patient-level datasets.

• 
The ability to formulate research questions, assess data fitness, interpret results responsibly, and explain findings to both technical and nontechnical colleagues.

• 
The organisation and initiative to move collaborative research forward across teams and institutions, with fluent written and spoken English.

• 
Experience in osteoarthritis or musculoskeletal research, patient stratification, biomarker research, distributed or federated analytics, and health-data governance would be an advantage.

You do not need experience in every area to apply.

What you'll do

• 
Design and conduct reproducible analyses of patient demographics, clinical characteristics, disease burden, and longitudinal outcomes across relevant osteoarthritis datasets.

• 
Investigate prognostic variables, patterns of disease progression, patient subgroups, treatment effectiveness, and candidate biomarkers or surrogate outcomes in support of relevant research questions.

• 
Work with data owners, WP3 infrastructure partners, internal data specialists, and governance teams to help establish data connections, permissions, harmonised definitions, and practical access to the federated database network.

• 
Apply appropriate statistical and machine-learning methods to heterogeneous real-world data, documenting assumptions, data quality, limitations, and validation results.

• 
Translate findings into scientific reports, presentations, publications, and consortium deliverables, including contributions to other areas where your analyses are relevant.

• 
Coordinate closely with the R&D RWE team and PPP team, and communicate progress and results to multidisciplinary public and private partners.

Who you'll work with

Within R&D RWE, you will work alongside epidemiologists and data scientists who use real-world patient data to inform disease understanding and research decisions. The PPP office will be a close partner in consortium coordination, scientific communication, and delivery of PROBE commitments.

About PROBE

Knee osteoarthritis affects people differently, making it difficult to predict progression and identify who may benefit from specific treatments. PROBE brings together patient data and expertise across academic, healthcare, industry, and patient partners to improve patient stratification, predictive models, endpoints, and clinical trial design. Its federated approach is intended to enable analysis across datasets while respecting applicable governance and privacy requirements.

What you can expect here

Work location: Søborg, Denmark.

Contract length: 2 years fixed-term contract

Expected start date: 1st January 2027

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 570,200 to 838,100 DKK (DK), corresponding to the level of the position.

The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Apply

jobs.occupation: Quality Engineer
jobs.description:
Are you the kind of person who notices when something could be better, and has the drive to make it happen? At DISA, quality is not just a checkpoint at the end of the process. It is built into the way we design, source, produce and deliver world-class foundry machines. We are looking for a Quality Engineer who wants to be close to the product, close to production and close to the decisions that improve how we work.

This role is for someone who enjoys solving real quality challenges in a manufacturing environment. Someone who is structured, curious and persistent enough to follow an issue from first observation to sustainable improvement.

What You’ll Do

• Take ownership of quality improvements across supplier quality, production quality and internal quality processes.

• Handle non-conformities, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions, and ensure follow-up until issues are properly closed.

• Work closely with production, engineering, procurement and suppliers to identify risks, solve quality challenges and prevent repeat issues.

• Support and develop supplier quality performance through audits, structured follow-up, documentation and improvement plans.

• Use data, facts and structured problem-solving tools to analyze trends, set priorities and recommend practical quality improvements.

• Contribute to audits, customer requirements and management systems, with ISO 14001 as an area where you have basic knowledge or interest.

Why You’ll Love Working with Us

• A role where quality is at the center — not a side responsibility.

• The chance to work hands-on with complex, high-precision equipment and see the impact of your improvements in real production.

• A workplace where your structure, curiosity and follow-through help prevent issues before they reach the customer.

• Close collaboration with production, engineering, procurement and suppliers, so you can turn observations into practical improvements.

• The opportunity to help strengthen quality culture in a global industrial company with strong products, proud craftsmanship and long product lifetimes.

You will not be sitting far away from the product or the people making it. You will be part of the daily dialogue around quality, helping colleagues and suppliers understand what went wrong, why it happened and how we make sure it does not happen again.

Who You Are

• You have a background in Engineering, Quality Management, Manufacturing, Production Technology or a similar field.

• You have experience with quality work in a manufacturing, production or industrial environment.

• You are motivated by root cause analysis, corrective actions and the satisfaction of closing issues properly.

• You understand supplier quality or are eager to work closely with suppliers on deviations, audits, documentation and improvement plans.

• You like being close to the shop floor and working with people across functions to solve practical quality challenges.

• You are analytical and structured, but also pragmatic enough to find solutions that work in real life.

• You follow through — because you know that quality improvements only matter when they are actually implemented and sustained.

• You have knowledge of ISO 14001 or an interest in building a basic understanding of environmental management systems.

If you are driven by quality, manufacturing and continuous improvement, and if you enjoy turning problems into clear actions and better ways of working, we would like to hear from you. You do not need to tick every box; what matters most is your quality mindset, your curiosity and your ability to follow through.

Want to know more? Ready to apply?

We will review candidates continuously, so please send your application as soon as possible. If you have any questions about the role, please contact Johnny Rasmussen at johnny.rasmussen@norican.com.

About Norican

NORICAN. Metal. Made. Possible.

We are Norican, a global industrial group designing, building and supporting bestinclass machines and technologies for metal formation and surface treatment.

Bringing together five leading brands - DISA, Simpson, StrikoWestofen, Wheelabrator and Monitizer – we deliver one connected solution across the production process, supported by fullservice expertise and digital solutions.

Across green sand molding, die casting, sand preparation, melting, transport and dosing, and surface treatment, we help manufacturers improve performance and transform production across a wide range of industries. We build lifetime quality and longterm partnerships by combining the strengths of our legacy brands to lead the industry through innovation, sustainability and profitable growth.

DISA:

DISA design, build and support premium green sand moulding and cashing machines for the ferrous and non-ferrous foundry industries. For 125 years they have delivered machines that last for decades, and they are highly respected by customers and peers for excellent levels of quality and service. DISA machines keep customers producing relentlessly to the very highest standards. And they empower foundry productivity with a lifetime of efficient and a lower cost per casting.

jobs.occupation: Senior Research Scientist for CMC Drug Product Development
jobs.description:
Your impact begins here

As our new Senior Research Scientist, you will play a leading scientific role in developing drug products across Novo’s development pipeline. You will apply your formulation expertise and industry experience across early- and late-stage projects, working with peptides, proteins, antibodies and minibinders to create stable, high-quality products that can reach patients worldwide.

You will join Chemistry, Manufacturing & Control (CMC) Development in Drug Product (DP) Development, where promising molecules are transformed into drug products that can progress through development and towards patients. As a Senior Research Scientist in DP Development, you will independently lead formulation activities and provide scientific direction from early development through later clinical stages. With sound judgement, strong ownership and a collaborative approach, you will guide colleagues, influence development decisions and help identify the right path forward for new medicines. Apply today!

What you’ll do

In this senior role, you will drive formulation and process development activities, ensuring robust pharmaceutical characteristics and product stability. You will take end-to-end scientific ownership within projects, anticipate formulation challenges and translate complex data into clear recommendations. You will also support, guide and develop colleagues, helping the team plan effectively and deliver with quality and confidence.

Your key outcomes will be to:

• 
Independently design, prioritise, interpret and report formulation studies that support the development of injectable drug products.

• 
Lead the planning and execution of studies in close collaboration with scientists, laboratory technicians and specialists, including coordination of team activities and priorities.

• 
Take ownership of high-quality documentation for internal and external purposes, including clinical trial applications and patent submissions.

• 
Provide scientific guidance, share formulation knowledge and support colleagues in making sound development decisions across the portfolio.

• 
Build strong cross-functional relationships and represent formulation perspectives with stakeholders across the Novo Nordisk value chain.

What you’ll bring

To succeed in this senior position, you bring a strong scientific foundation, substantial hands-on experience from industry and a proven ability to drive drug product development activities independently. You can turn complex formulation questions into clear scientific recommendations, make well-reasoned decisions and communicate effectively with colleagues and stakeholders from different backgrounds.

The qualifications we are looking for include:

• 
A PhD or Master’s degree in Pharmaceutical Sciences, Engineering or another relevant natural science field.

• 
Solid industry experience within research and development and drug product development. This is a mandatory requirement.

• 
Strong hands-on experience with injectable protein, peptide, antibody or minibinder formulation and stability studies.

• 
Experience with phase-appropriate quality expectations, scientific documentation and drug product development across clinical phases.

Additionally, you are fluent in written and spoken English and comfortable working in a multi-stakeholder environment. Experience with clinical trial application documentation, patent submissions, cross-functional portfolio knowledge sharing or coordination of team activities will be an advantage.

On a personal level, you are self-driven and proactive, taking ownership of progress and delivering on commitments. You work independently, contribute positively to the team and build strong, trusting relationships. You apply sound judgement to bring clarity and direction to scientific questions, and support, lead and guide colleagues by sharing expertise, offering constructive input and modelling high scientific standards and collaboration. You plan, coordinate and balance priorities effectively, helping the team achieve shared goals in a dynamic environment.

Who you’ll work with

In CMC DP Development, we are approximately 200 colleagues working on developing formulations and production processes for injectable and oral biopharmaceutical products. You will work closely with scientists, laboratory technicians, specialists and project stakeholders across Global Research, Regulatory Affairs, Quality Assurance, Analytical Development and Global Manufacturing and Supply. The collaboration spans projects from early development through late-stage development and process validation.

What you can expect here

At Novo Nordisk, you can expect a role where your scientific judgement matters and where you will have the mandate to shape formulation strategies and move complex development projects forward. You will have opportunities to deepen your expertise, strengthen your cross-functional influence and contribute as a senior scientific role model in a collaborative environment.

You will be trusted to work independently, take ownership and guide others, while contributing to work that helps create progress for people living with serious chronic diseases.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from DKK 651,000 to DKK 956,900, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate’s skills, competencies, knowledge, and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks. Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here.

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to bring your industry experience, scientific leadership and formulation expertise to drug products for the future, apply for the Senior Research Scientist role by:

8 November 2026

We expect to run 1st interviews in week 47 and 2nd interviews in week 48.

For further information, please contact Drago Sticker at: +45-30753949.

While not mandatory, we strongly encourage you to include a few lines in your cv explaining why this role is the right next step for you. Please refrain from adding a photo to your CV to ensure fair and efficient processing.

We commit to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
